conviction_note: The findings sum to +0.7 and the scaled number is +0.45 (p_up 55 x abs 4.5). Both lean slightly positive. The NII line points up: consensus of $1.39B sits at the top of the path implied by the company's own guide, and STT's NII came in flat QoQ, beat, and its guide was raised today. But STT was sold 8.7% on an in-line print with a raised NII guide. That is direct evidence that this quarter's custody tape does not pay for the NII line, so p_up stays close to 50, while abs_move sits above the 4.04 implied move.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS $2.26-2.27, revenue $5.55-5.56B, from two agreeing sources: Zacks via TradingView, https://www.tradingview.com/news/zacks:f0cf352fc094b:0-growth-in-fee-income-higher-nii-likely-to-support-bny-s-q3-earnings/ (EPS $2.26, revenue $5.56B, NII $1.39B, investment services fees $2.85B, FX $204M), and Hudson Labs 2026-09-28, https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/bny-q3-2026-earnings-revenue-preview-guidance-key-metrics (EPS $2.27, revenue $5,546M). Company FY2026 guide from the Q2 call: revenue +10-11%, NII +12-13%, expenses ex-notables +6-7%. With FY2025 NII of $4,944M (https://app.boardroomalpha.com/sec_feed/2026/QTR1/0001390777-26-000004/ex991_earningsreleasex4q25.htm) and H1 2026 NII of about $2,810M (Q2 $1,446M, +6% QoQ, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001390777/000139077726000071/ex991_earningsreleasex2q26.htm), the guide implies an H2 average of $1,364-1,389M a quarter.
positioning_check: Short interest 8.42m shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, about 1.2% of shares outstanding, 1.85 days to cover (https://equibles.com/stocks/bny/short-interest, via sweep row, read 2026-10-14). ORTEX 2026-10-12 puts it at 1.5% of float, borrow unconstrained, and a put/call ratio of 1.75 built up as a hedge through September (https://ortex.news/articles/185238/bny-mellon-analysts-debate-capital-cushions-as-the-october-print-arrives). Not a crowded short. Baseline 25-delta skew is -3.5 vol points (calls richer, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.46, event-implied move 4.04% (ATM spread 43% of mid, so indicative only). Tape: ATH 165.84 on 2026-09-04, spot 136.76, -10.9% over 20 days, -4.2% over 5 days, -3.3% on 2026-10-14 alone (141.03 to 136.38) in sympathy with STT's -8.7% print (Yahoo chart, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BNY?range=1mo&interval=1d).

findings.finding: Consensus Q3 NII of $1.39B (-4% QoQ from $1,446M) sits at the top of the $1,364-1,389M quarterly path implied by BNY's own FY guide (+12-13% on $4,944M FY2025 with H1 at about $2,810M). Last year Q3 NII rose QoQ ($1,236M against about $1,205M). STT reported today, after BNY last spoke, with NII flat QoQ ($864M against $854M expected) and raised its FY NII guide to +15-16%. So a Q3 NII print of $1.40-1.43B and a raise of the 12-13% FY NII guide are the likely outcome; the bar the market holds is the guide's top, not above it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-15: Q2 NII +20% YoY with the FY NII guide raised from ~10% to 12-13% bought +5.08% (baseline). 2025-01-15 +8.03%. 2025-10-16, a Q3 beat with no guide change, -2.03%. Peer read this quarter: STT beat NII and raised its NII guide on 2026-10-14 and still fell 8.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus NII of $1.39B was set before STT's print. If the market already expected a beat and a raise, the Zacks NII estimate would sit above the guide-implied range rather than at its top, and BNY would not have fallen 3.3% in sympathy with STT on a day STT's NII beat.
findings.independence: BNY's own guide arithmetic, from the Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001390777/000139077726000071/ex991_earningsreleasex2q26.htm) and the Q4 2025 release. CFO McDonogh on 2026-09-14: NII 'has performed or outperformed relative to expectations', with a ~150bp yield pickup on maturing securities (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/bny-mellon-at-barclays-conference-growth-ai-and-crosssell-push-93CH-4899943). Newsquawk STT NII beat headline: https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/state-street-stt-q3-2026-usd-eps-369-exp-368-revenue-4bln-exp-403bln-nii-864mln-exp-8541mln

findings.finding: At Barclays on 2026-09-14, two weeks before quarter end, CFO McDonogh did not walk back the guide ('I feel pretty good about where that guide is relative to the performance'). He said Q3 deposits were slower, as flagged in July, and activity softer than Q2, but that 'volumes are strong and have kicked back into September'. He said expenses are 'well contained' within the 6-7% guide. STT raised its expense guide today (to 8-8.5% from ~8%), and that raise was one of the cited causes of its drop.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No intra-quarter pre-signal history in the baseline. The July 2025 print (-0.09%), on a guide reaffirmation, was flat.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it was a public conference a month ago. The part not priced is the contrast with STT's expense raise today. If the market were distinguishing the two names on expenses, BNY would not have taken a third of STT's drop on 2026-10-14.
findings.independence: STT expense-guide raise: https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9123268/state-street-stt-shares-drop-85-premarket-after-q3-revenue-miss. The primary document for BNY's comments is the conference transcript only.

findings.finding: Equity markets rose 15% in Q2 and 2-2.3% more in Q3 2026, so Q3 average asset levels sat above Q2's. STT's servicing fees rose 2% QoQ to a record $1,492M, with AUC/A a record $59.2T (+2% QoQ). BNY's consensus investment services fees of $2.85B are -2% QoQ, against last year's Q3, when that line rose QoQ ($2,585M vs about $2,574M). That leaves room for a fee-line beat, though Q2 2026 was inflated by seasonal depositary-receipt and volume effects (+10% QoQ).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Fee-led beats: 2026-04-16 +2.18%, 2026-01-13 +1.88% (baseline). STT's servicing fee record this quarter did not protect its stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus for this line implies a QoQ decline that last year's seasonality did not show. If analysts had marked to Q3 asset levels, the estimate would be flat to up QoQ, as STT's servicing fees were.
findings.independence: Proxy plus peer: STT servicing fees and AUC/A from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000093751/000009375126000592/a3q26earningspressrelease.htm (the same document as finding 1, a different line). S&P Q3 return also at https://novelinvestor.com/2026-q3-returns/

findings.finding: The 10-year Treasury rose from about 4.41% (2026-06-24) to about 5.0% by late September, and the Fed hiked 25bp on 2026-09-16. For a Category I bank whose CET1 includes AOCI (11.0% at Q2, down from 11.5% a year earlier; SLR 6.3% from 6.9%), that pressures the ratio and possibly the $1.1B-a-quarter buyback pace. ORTEX names capital ratios as the bears' focus. Partly contradicted by STT, whose CET1 rose 0.2pp to 11.0% despite lower AOCI.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No capital-ratio surprise in the baseline's eight prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Already being debated, and the stock is down 17% with P/E compressed to ~14.2x. What is not known is BNY's Q3 CET1 number. A visible pricing of a buyback cut would show as BNY underperforming STT into the print, and it did not (both about -7% to -9% over the month before today).
findings.independence: Fed hike: https://federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260916a.htm. Counter-evidence, STT CET1 up: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000093751/000009375126000592/a3q26earningspressrelease.htm

findings.why_not_priced: The BNY FX estimate predates STT's print. It is a small line (~4% of revenue), so it barely matters to price either way.

findings.finding: Reaction function this quarter: STT, the closest peer, printed EPS of $3.69 against $3.67-3.68 and NII above consensus, and raised its FY fee guide (13-14%) and NII guide (15-16%). It still fell 8.7% on 2026-10-14, on a 1% revenue miss ($4.00B vs $4.04B), fee revenue -2% QoQ and an expense guide nudge. Custody prints that are in line are being sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BNY has sold beats before: 2025-10-16 -2.03% on a Q3 beat (baseline). STT -8.7% today. BNY's own last two prints were bought (+5.08%, +2.18%).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: BNY fell 3.3% on the day, about 38% of STT's move. If the market had fully transferred STT's reaction function to BNY, the gap would be closer to STT's; it was not. A hot CPI the same day (S&P down) adds macro headwind for banks.

findings.finding: BNY enters the print de-rated and hedged. It is down 17.5% from the 2026-09-04 ATH of 165.84 (to 136.76), against -6.8% for the S&P US BMI Banks index in September. P/E has compressed ~2.2 points to ~14.2x. Five targets were cut in early October (Citi to $160, BofA to $161, BMO to $160, Evercore to $150, TD Cowen Hold $160). The put/call ratio was held ~1.75 through September, but 25-delta skew is -3.5 (calls richer) and short interest is only ~1.2%. Expectations reset lower with hedges already in place leaves room for a relief move on a clean print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 5 of 7 baseline prints were up. The largest, +8.03% (2025-01) and +5.08% (2026-07), were both guide raises.
findings.why_not_priced: This is positioning, not a fact. The baseline skew already leans up. The STT example (similar -7% month, still -8.7%) argues the de-rating did not protect a peer, which is why this finding is sized smaller than the drawdown alone would suggest.

baseline_tension: The skew (-3.5, upside paid), low short interest and a -10.9% 20-day run-up all lean the same way as my slight positive. The one cut against it is STT's -8.7% on a similar in-line print today, which holds p_up at 55 rather than higher.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1, verified fact is not a predicted reaction: the NII/guide finding cut from +1.2 to +0.8, because STT got an NII beat and guide raise this quarter and still fell 8.7%.
Lesson 6, bar inside the guide: consensus NII sits at the top of the guided path, so a beat is a guidance-line event; refiled as lands_on guidance, size held after the lesson-1 cut.
Lesson 5, proxy loses to document: market-level fee proxy cut from +0.5 to +0.4; peer STT servicing fees keep it filed.
Lesson 3, own caveat reaches the number: AOCI/capital finding cut from -0.4 to -0.2, because STT's CET1 rose despite lower AOCI.
CFO conference comments cut from +0.3 to +0.2 as public and mostly priced.
Left standing: FX -0.2, STT reaction function -0.8, de-rating +0.5. p_up 55 and abs 4.5 unchanged.
